subject: Request: Promo credit + discount for Kryptonix Labs POC
messages:
From: Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@kryptonixlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@kryptonixlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Promo support for extended POC

Jonas —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We ran the new multi-model pipeline across our ingestion set and the results are very promising, but scope has materially increased compared to the original POC. To validate production readiness we need a bit more runway.

Ask: would Redwood consider a 3-month trial extension + $15,000 platform credit, and a 20% discount on our first-year committed spend if we move forward with a 12-month commitment?

Rationale: expanding to the full dataset will double token usage during evaluation and adds integration time for our ops team. We’re prepared to talk about an on-contract commit this week if you can bridge the delta on credits/discounts.

Attaching the revised SOW for background (Kryptonix-SOW.pdf). Happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Tom Garcia
Senior Engineering Manager
Kryptonix Labs
attachments: [Kryptonix-SOW.pdf]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@kryptonixlabs.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@kryptonixlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Promo support for extended POC

Tom —

Really glad the run looked promising. Appreciate the SOW; that helps. I want to get this routed to approvals quickly so we can keep momentum.

Summary of your ask (so we’re all aligned):
- 3-month trial extension
- $15k credit applied to platform usage during the extended period
- 20% discount on year-one committed spend (12-month contract)

Internal note to Marissa/Grace/Aditya — can you review the commercial impact quickly? My recommendation: we try to preserve the upsell by asking for a 6–9 month minimum commit in exchange for the concession, and consider splitting credit vs discount (sized credit to cover trial delta, discount to incent commit). I’ll draft an exec petition once we agree on numbers.

Tom/Priya — I’ll circle back with a formal counter by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: Promo support for extended POC

Team —

I reviewed the SOW and Jonas’s notes. Quick commercial take: Kryptonix is strategically interesting (edge industrial vertical, potential for multi-product expansion). We should be flexible, but prefer a split approach:

Option A (recommended):
- $10,000 trial credit (applied to extended POC usage)
- 15% discount on year-one committed spend
- Require a minimum 6-month commit at signing

Option B (stretch):
- $15,000 credit + 20% discount if they commit to 12 months and agree to a structured adoption plan (monthly checkpoints + usage milestones).

I’m attaching a one-pager that sketches the margin impact and recommended guardrails. If leadership wants to be competitive, Option B is ok but we should insist on the adoption milestones and an exec sponsor on their side.

marissa_note.pdf attached.

-Marissa
Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: [marissa_note.pdf]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: Promo support for extended POC — finance impact & ask for exec signoff

Folks —

I ran quick unit economics on both options. Conservative view:
- Option A (10k + 15% / 6mo commit): NPV positive at ~10% over 12 months assuming 60% retention into year 2.
- Option B (15k + 20% / 12mo commit): NPV neutral to slightly negative in worst case but higher upside if they expand.

Recommendation: seek Option B but put a cap on credit payout (credit applies only to usage that exceeds the originally scoped POC baseline) and require their finance contact to sign the adoption milestones.

Please escalate to Sean for final approval. Draft ask below for exec note: 

--- Exec Ask (copy/paste) ---
Approve a one-time compromise for Kryptonix Labs: $12,000 platform credit + 18% discount on year-one committed spend in exchange for a 9-month minimum contract and a signed adoption plan with monthly checkpoints. Credit capped to additional usage above the original POC baseline.
--- End ---

If we get quick approval I’ll prepare the quote and DocuSign.

-Aditya
Head of Revenue Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: RE: Request: Promo support for extended POC — exec approval requested

Sean —

Forwarding for your approval. Quick context: Kryptonix (edge industrial) asks for 3-month extension plus $15k credit + 20% discount. Sales ops and Rev strategy recommend a middle-ground: $12k credit + 18% discount with a 9-month commit and adoption milestones. We believe this materially increases the probability of conversion and sets clear guardrails.

Key risks: short-term margin hit if they churn quickly. Mitigations: cap credit to incremental usage and require adoption signoff.

If you approve I’ll instruct Jonas to send the counteroffer and I’ll attach the FINAL quote.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Head of Growth
Redwood Inference

To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: RE: Request: Promo support for extended POC — exec approval requested

Approved with a small tweak — we can do the concession but tighten the commit term slightly. Approve: $12,000 platform credit + 18% off year-one committed spend, contingent on a 9-month minimum contract and a signed adoption plan that includes four monthly checkpoints and a usage ramp schedule. Credit is capped to incremental usage above the originally scoped POC and will be applied as account-level credits over the first three billing cycles after go-live.

Jonas — please send this counter to Tom and Priya, include the attached FINAL quote, and request their legal/finance contact for the adoption-signoff. Also add a clause: credit void if account cancels within first 60 days after commit.

Approve and move forward.

- Sean Gallagher
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
